operation: On the v2 backing, open built-in lesson 102 Transitions and Values. Select ClockworkIris and set its brightness to 37%. Open Patterns (3), then Try with Pattern, and set Pattern 2 to Caustics. Capture 1 shows the edited lesson. Then use Show actions, then Clone. Capture 2 shows the copy opened in the existing editor: '102 Transitions and Values copy', with ClockworkIris at 37% and the Caustics Clip. Capture 3 renders the copy as a stored v2 row (GET /api/shows, v2 documents): clip-iris brightness 0.37, and instance horizon is Caustics. Before this change the v2 header Clone copied the stock v1 definition as a v1 row, dropping both edits. Items 4, 6 and 7 of this commit have no visible surface; tracer and unit cases cover them. Capture 4 is the raw response of GET /api/shows?show-version=2, which the authenticated page navigates to right after the Clone. The fresh test account holds only this Show: version 2, named "102 Transitions and Values copy", with clip-iris brightness 0.37 and instance horizon set to Caustics.
